sources.primary_title: Justice Ministry Presents Enhancements to User Experience and AI Applications at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: The Saudi Ministry of Justice is participating in the LEAP 2026 conference, highlighting its integration of artificial intelligence and data to redesign judicial services from a user-centric perspective. The ministry introduced a "Rights Protection System" at its exhibition stand, which focuses on four key pillars: prevention, clarity, quality, and enforcement. This system is designed to safeguard rights before disputes arise, enhance the user experience, improve the quality of judicial work, and empower related legal professions. The initiative represents the next phase of the ministry's digital transformation journey, moving toward institutional maturity and the application of technology to raise the quality of judicial outcomes. This announcement is distinct and not duplicated in the existing coverage inventory.
